definitions.explanation: Something that is invented or imagined rather than real; a made-up story or false claim.

examples.japanese: {事実|じじつ}⟦と→と：00068_to⟧{虚構|きょこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{区別|くべつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{虚構|きょこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{世界|せかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浸|ひた}る→浸る：04889_hitaru⟧。
examples.english: To immerse oneself in a fictional world.

notes:
{虚構|きょこう} refers to things that are fictional or fabricated.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {虚構|きょこう}の{世界|せかい} (fictional world)
- {虚構|きょこう}の{物語|ものがたり} (fictional story)
- {虚構|きょこう}と{現実|げんじつ} (fiction and reality)
- {虚構|きょこう}に{基|もと}づく (based on fiction)

RELATED TERMS:
- フィクション: fiction (loanword)
- {創作|そうさく}: creation, fiction
- {作|つく}り{話|ばなし}: made-up story
- {事実|じじつ}: fact (opposite)
- {現実|げんじつ}: reality (opposite)
- ノンフィクション: non-fiction
